sections.content: You know *me parece que* from B1 Unit 7. New here: *resultar* + adjective gives a judgement about a work and means "to come across as" or "to turn out to be". The adjective agrees with the thing you judge: *El argumento resulta convincente*, *Los personajes resultan convincentes*. Connect every judgement to a feature such as the plot, the characters or the performance.

items.spanish: La película me parece original y entretenida.
items.english: The film seems original and entertaining to me.

items.spanish: La historia no me parece demasiado interesante.
items.english: The story does not seem very interesting to me.

sections.content: *Resultar* is used with the same adjectives as *ser*, but it sounds like a considered judgement: *El final resulta previsible porque ya conocemos la historia.*
